headline: Of the seven MissionSceneLoadHost methods the executable still reports unimplemented, two already had reconstructions (00447060 and 004d87b0 in include/bsp/mission_state_frame.hpp) and are reused, and three of the remaining five were misnamed by the interface: 004cec60 is an MSVC _Tree node eraser and not a network-slot reset, the 004e0754 block resets the avoid-zone table and not an objective list, and the scripted-name list is the set of Lua global FUNCTION names captured at state 0Ch so that teardown can nil every function the mission scripts added.

004cec60.ecx: the owning tree; only propagated to the recursive call, never dereferenced
004cec60.note: MSVC std::_Tree::_Erase: recursive on node+8h, iterative on node+0h, value is a native string at node+0Ch (length) / node+10h (buffer). The loop back edge at 004cec9c..004cecab is raw bytes in Ghidra's listing and had to be decoded from 83 c4 04 80 7e 15 00 8b fe 74 c5.

004218e0.note: Thread-safe lazy singleton: critical section from BSP_SingletonLifetime_GetManager, operator new(0x78) at 0042193a, constructor 00421500, registration through 00bd0c30.

00424d00.note: Scans [[00e188a8]+19cch]+370h, an intrusive list walked through node+4h with the element at node+8h and its name at element+154h/+158h. Literals AvoidZone, AvoidZoneG and 'AvoidZoneG %*s %d #%03d'.

004d32a0.note: The reader of the set 004d30f0 fills. Returns at 004d32d2 when game+1938h is 0.

00b66200.note: lua_type(...) == 6 (LUA_TFUNCTION); the unbound arm at 00b66209 forces -1 and compares it to 6, so an unbound object is not a function.

004c9ca0.note: Already read in full by packet cc_exe_2j; only the load arm's loading element was added here.

open_questions: The list at 00f87198 that 004c3840 walks has no writer in its xref set: 004c3840, 004c3a80, 004d56e0, 0076f2b0, 0077c540, 0077e4c0, 0077f0e0 and 0077f5e0 all read it. Its element type is a unit-like object (+5ch/+5dh/+5eh as docs/UNIT_INSTANCE_LAYOUT.md, an owner slot at +188h, a float at +304h) but the producer is unread.
The candidate vtable slots +10h and +148h were not opened; only their argument shape and the log's use of +10h's result are established.
The two global trees 00e18a60 and 00e18a6c that the network-slot reset clears are referenced only by 004dfb70, 004da780 and their static constructors, so nothing in the xref set inserts into them.
The tree at game+5c8h that the avoid-zone step clears has a POD element (no value destructor in the inlined erase) and no identified producer.

004c3840 keeps three party rosters while docs/VEHICLE_CLASS_DESCRIPTORS.md reports the party bitmap row as stride 3 with the third byte unexplained, and 004d87b0's side counters are likewise a three-slot array indexed by slot+28h. The third party is consistent across all three but nothing was found that fills it.
